$comment: Registry of every kya distribution channel: the single source of truth the maintainers' release fan-out gate and daily drift watchdog read. Every channel kya has or plans is listed with how its version is updated and a live probe. A file under the package that carries a version must be a channel file here or be listed in not_channels with a reason, or CI fails. Paths are relative to the maintainers' monorepo root; {version} in a probe url is the version under test. No version pins in this file.

update_values.auto-pipeline: a monorepo Woodpecker workflow updates it on every kya-v* tag; a lag after grace_hours is red
update_values.auto-mirror: it lives in the public repo The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya, which kya-public-sync mirrors on every tag; a lag after grace_hours is red
update_values.auto-runtime: it installs npm latest when it runs; nothing to bump per release
update_values.manual-owner: a human updates it; always printed as UNRESOLVED with the action, never green
update_values.not-built: planned or drafted, not published; always printed as UNRESOLVED with what blocks it

channels.action: Not on public main yet: the next kya-v* tag mirrors .plugin/marketplace.json and plugins/kya-copilot/plugin.json (version bumped by pnpm sync:version like the other plugin manifests). Once that tag is live and the probe reads its version, set update to auto-mirror with grace_hours 3.

The entry pins that ref, so later releases stay listed at the old version until the owner sends an update through the same form; their re-review runs every 6 months.
